basis: Independent review of the released D-P02 brief, revealed plan, and investigator package. Investigator source records are carried forward unchanged; critic additions use distinct IDs.
source_policy: Public primary standards, official library documentation/release history, and upstream issue/PR history. No raw page captures, binaries or downloaded code retained. Source IDs are stable within this stage and are not reused or rebound.

sources.title: CIPA Exif standard listing
sources.released_version_or_commit: CIPA DC-008-Translation-2026, Exif Version 3.1; published 2026-01-30
sources.locator: Digital Cameras > CIPA DC-008-Translation-2026; publication date and predecessor shown in listing.
sources.observed_operation: Read official CIPA standards listing to identify the released Exif edition; direct download route requires accepting a disclaimer and was not used.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The listed 2026 edition supersedes the 2024 edition. This listing establishes the current edition/date, not the detailed tag table.
sources.applicability: Use as governing format-version identity; obtain/check the full current standard when implementing tag-level behavior.

sources.title: PNG Specification, Second Edition
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, PNG Specification Second Edition, 2003-11-10
sources.locator: Sections on color space/significant chunks (iCCP, sRGB, gAMA/cHRM), transparency/alpha representation, and decoder recommendations.
sources.observed_operation: Consulted W3C spec excerpt for iCCP precedence and non-premultiplied alpha statements.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: PNG alpha samples are unassociated; an iCCP profile identifies sample color space and has precedence over gAMA/cHRM when recognized by a color-managed decoder.
sources.applicability: Format constraints; they do not prescribe an application's resampling kernel or prove how a particular library handles alpha.

sources.title: ICC.1:2022 profile format specification
sources.released_version_or_commit: ICC.1:2022, profile version 4.4.0.0
sources.locator: ICC specifications page/PDF title and profile-format clauses; detailed clauses were not quoted in discovery.
sources.observed_operation: Identified current ICC.1 specification and profile version on the ICC official specifications page.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Profiles characterize source/output color spaces; an application still chooses transforms, rendering intent and policies for absent/invalid profiles.
sources.applicability: Color-management vocabulary and profile identity; candidate APIs determine executable transform behavior.

sources.title: Sharp release v0.35.5
sources.released_version_or_commit: Sharp v0.35.5; release commit shown as 51a990f; linked sharp-libvips dependency release v1.3.4.
sources.locator: v0.35.5 release notes and linked sharp-libvips release.
sources.observed_operation: Read upstream release listing; checked latest tag and dependency/release notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release includes fixes and updates; binary/codec availability remains platform/build-specific.
sources.applicability: Maintained Node binding alternative and version pin; does not establish suitability for a non-Node host.

sources.title: Sharp input metadata API
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Sharp documentation consulted with v0.35.5 release identified separately.
sources.locator: metadata() API; dimensions/orientation/pages/profile fields.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official API page and read metadata() description.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Metadata is read from the file header without decoding compressed pixels; width/height do not account for EXIF orientation.
sources.applicability: Useful intake preflight; header-only inspection is not proof dimensions are trustworthy or decode is safe.

sources.title: Sharp constructor and limits
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Sharp documentation consulted with v0.35.5 release identified separately.
sources.locator: Constructor options failOn and limitInputPixels.
sources.observed_operation: Found and opened official constructor option descriptions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: failOn defaults to warning; invalid metadata always aborts. limitInputPixels defaults to 268402689 and assumes metadata dimensions can be trusted; false/zero removes the limit.
sources.applicability: Shows a configurable decoder guard and its trust boundary; set a product limit and worker ceilings.

sources.title: Sharp image operations
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Sharp documentation consulted with v0.35.5 release identified separately.
sources.locator: rotate() and autoOrient() sections.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official operation documentation and read rotation ordering/orientation behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: autoOrient reads EXIF Orientation and removes the tag; orientation carried elsewhere such as XMP is not handled. Order matters for rotate/resize/extract; multipage limitations apply.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit single orientation stage and fixture needs; not a guarantee for every decoder/format.

sources.title: Sharp output, profiles and metadata
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Sharp documentation consulted with v0.35.5 release identified separately.
sources.locator: keepIccProfile(), withIccProfile(), keepMetadata(), withMetadata(); JPEG defaults.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official API page and read output profile/metadata policy descriptions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Without keepMetadata, output converts to sRGB and strips metadata including ICC; keepMetadata retains EXIF, ICC, XMP and IPTC; withMetadata keeps most descriptive metadata and adds sRGB ICC if appropriate. JPEG defaults include quality 80 and 4:2:0 chroma subsampling.
sources.applicability: Concrete default/privacy/color behavior to override explicitly per output role.

sources.title: Pillow ImageOps 12.3.0
sources.released_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable docs; release tag commit bb1d8e8.
sources.locator: ImageOps.exif_transpose() section.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Pillow stable API docs; confirmed version and transpose behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If EXIF Orientation is present and not 1, transpose accordingly and remove orientation data; in_place defaults false.
sources.applicability: Candidate API; verify TIFF decoder behavior and original-image immutability in pinned release.

sources.title: Pillow ImageCms 12.3.0
sources.released_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable docs; release tag commit bb1d8e8.
sources.locator: profileToProfile() API and renderingIntent argument.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official API docs at transform function.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applies ICC transform from inputProfile to outputProfile; rendering intent defaults to perceptual; invalid profiles or unsupported output modes raise PyCMSError.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit color conversion and profile-failure handling.

sources.title: Pillow Image limits
sources.released_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable docs; release tag commit bb1d8e8.
sources.locator: Decompression-bomb warning/error discussion near Image.open().
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs and inspected warning/error threshold behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Above MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS emits DecompressionBombWarning; callers can promote to error; over twice the threshold raises DecompressionBombError. Threshold may be changed or disabled.
sources.applicability: Useful explicit guard behavior; component must set its own threshold.

sources.title: Pillow exif_transpose regression #5580 and fix #5584
sources.released_version_or_commit: Bug on Pillow 8.3.0; PR #5584 fix reported released in Pillow 8.3.1 (2021).
sources.locator: Issue reproduction, linked PR #5584 and maintainer comment reporting 8.3.1 fix.
sources.observed_operation: Read upstream issue and release-resolution comments.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Change intended to avoid EXIF mutation exposed KeyError when deleting orientation from alternate EXIF data; fix merged/released.
sources.applicability: Test decode/storage variants and unchanged original, not only visible rotation.

sources.title: Pillow TIFF YCbCr orientation issue and fix
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR #8556 merged 2025-03-29; release version not asserted in inspected PR.
sources.locator: PR description/comments linked to #8554; libtiff applies orientation during TIFFRGBAImage decode.
sources.observed_operation: Opened upstream PR and read merge date, linked issue, and TIFF/libtiff explanation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: For YCbCr TIFF, libtiff may apply orientation during decode; Pillow removes orientation metadata to prevent later double transpose.
sources.applicability: Decoder path and format matter; test pinned stack rather than assuming the application always owns orientation.

sources.title: libvips autorot and thumbnail issue #1523
sources.released_version_or_commit: libvips 8.8.4 vs 8.9.0 behavior reported (2020).
sources.locator: Issue body describing API sequence, metadata behavior change, and thumbnail_image auto-rotation interaction.
sources.observed_operation: Opened upstream issue; compared reported version-dependent output and no_rotate workaround.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Thumbnail helper may apply rotation itself; earlier explicit autorot can cause a version-dependent extra or missing rotation.
sources.applicability: Historical regression; record exact release and operation path.

sources.title: libvips linear ICC thumbnail issue #4343
sources.released_version_or_commit: libvips 8.16.0 reported (2025-01-06).
sources.locator: Issue description: private Apple Wide Color Sharing Profile input, linear thumbnail, icc_transform workaround.
sources.observed_operation: Opened upstream issue and read reproduction and unshared-fixture statement.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: One unshared input failed in a linear/profile-transform path; reporter said other inputs worked. Generality and resolution are not established.
sources.applicability: Conditional risk evidence only; do not generalize or call it a confirmed current defect/fix.

sources.title: ImageMagick command-line options
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current online docs inspected 2026-10-12; latest changelog observed as 7.1.2-33.
sources.locator: -auto-orient, -profile, -strip, -limit and resource-limit discussion.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current command-option docs and located behavior for orientation, profiles, stripping and resources.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: -auto-orient reads/resets EXIF Orientation and does nothing if EXIF was stripped; -profile is ordered and depends on included profiles; -strip removes profiles/comments and PNG color chunks; limits can spill memory/map work to disk and fail at configured hard disk limit; defaults are host-adjusted.
sources.applicability: Explicit controls, but operation order, defaults and delegates require deliberate version pinning/tests.

sources.title: ImageMagick changelog
sources.released_version_or_commit: ImageMagick 7.1.2-33 dated 2026-10-10.
sources.locator: Latest changelog heading and merged fixes/security entries.
sources.observed_operation: Opened upstream changelog and read latest release heading.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release history identifies the current release at access; it does not establish orientation behavior for this case.
sources.applicability: Candidate version identity only; verify installed delegates and exact build.

sources.title: ImageMagick TIFF orientation issue #7147
sources.released_version_or_commit: Reporter used ImageMagick 7.1.1-29 on Windows (2024); attempted patch and revert discussed March 2024.
sources.locator: TIFF page reproduction using JPEG and LZW compression; patch/revert discussion.
sources.observed_operation: Read upstream issue report and history search result; checked reported compressed-page cases and patch/revert notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Orientation differed across TIFF compression/page cases; attempted fix reportedly regressed other tested inputs and maintainers reported reverting it.
sources.applicability: Do not treat issue closure or one fixture as proof; test both compression paths against current pinned version.

sources.title: W3C PNG Specification, Third Edition
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, 2025-06-24
sources.locator: §6.2 alpha representation; §11.3.2 color-space chunks; §11.3.3 text; §11.3.4.5 eXIf; §13.4 privacy; edition heading.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current W3C Recommendation; checked edition identity, alpha representation, eXIf, color/text chunks and privacy guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: PNG samples are unassociated-alpha. PNG can carry eXIf, text and color chunks; eXIf can conflict with other chunks and may describe historical source data. Third Edition is current.
sources.applicability: The investigator's alpha fact remains valid, but this current edition is needed for a current PNG metadata inventory. It does not prescribe the application's resampling filter.

sources.locator: Release-note version index and 12.3.0 heading.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official release notes and confirmed the documented version/date.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release identity does not prove a particular installation or codec build.
sources.applicability: Confirms Pillow documentation version; native codec/build matrix remains a selection and validation item.

critic_scope_note: SRC-PNG-02 remains bound to the 2003 Second Edition and is not rebound. CRITIC-PNG-01 records the current Third Edition.
